data.long_meaning: In Greek, Alexi means 'helper' or 'defender of the people'. This name has its roots in ancient Greece and was borne by several saints. It is also mentioned in the New Testament as the name of a companion of Saint Paul. The name Alexi carries the meaning “Defender of the people” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alexi usually hope their child will grow to embody defender of the people and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: אלכסי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלכסי הוא שם שפירושו 'מגן ומושיע', שמקורו בשם היווני 'אלכסיוס' (Alexios), שמשמעותו 'מגן האנושות'. השם אלכסי קשור קשר הדוק לערכים של הגנה, הצלה וישועה, שמקורם בתפיסות הרוחניות והמוסריות של היהדות והנצרות.

in_greek.name: Αλέξι
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Αλέξις είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από το 'Αλέξιος' (Alexios), που σημαίνει 'αμυνόμενος' ή 'προφυλακτής'. Στην παράδοση της Ορθόδοξης Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Αλέξι συνδέεται με την προστασία και τη σωτηρία, αντανακλώντας τις αρετές της πίστης, της ελπίδας και της αγάπης.

in_latin.name: Alexi
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Alexi derivatum est ex nomine Graeco 'Alexios', quod significat 'defensor' vel 'servator'. In traditione Christiana, nomen Alexi refertur ad protectionem et salvationem, exprimens virtutes fidei, spei et caritatis.

in_english.name: Alexi
in_english.meaning: Defender of the people, protector and savior
in_english.long_meaning: The name Alexi originates from the Greek 'Alexios', meaning 'defender' or 'protector'. It carries significant spiritual connotations, symbolizing a guardian or savior figure. Historically, the name has been associated with various Christian saints and martyrs, embodying virtues of courage, faith, and selflessness. In modern usage, Alexi remains a popular name across different Christian cultures, reflecting its enduring appeal and meaningful heritage.

data.cultural_impact: The name Alexi has been present in Christian history for centuries. It is a name that has been associated with strength, leadership, and protection. Alexi was the name of several saints in the Orthodox Church, including Saint Alexis of Wesham and Saint Alexis of Moscow. These saints were revered for their bravery, dedication to their faith, and their ability to help those in need. The name Alexi continued to be popular among Christians, particularly in Eastern Europe.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Alexi holds deep spiritual significance for many Christians. As 'helper' or 'defender of the people', this name is a reminder of God’s unending love and protection. It serves as a call to live a life of service, to be a helper and defender to those in need, just as God is to us. The name Alexi also represents the idea of being a holy defender, guarding against temptation and sin, and working to spread the word of God. Ultimately, the name Alexi embodies the Christian virtues of love, compassion, and bravery.
